The Dutch '''[[Eredivisie]] in the 1965–66 season''' was contested by 16 teams. [[AFC Ajax|Ajax]] won the championship. Only one team was relegated this season, because in the next, the number of participants would be 18 again.

==Teams==

A total of 16 teams are taking part in the league.
